angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 528,732 km at 37.84 pc = 0.19 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 26.4274 +/- 0.0108 mas (same row, RUWE 0.95): 37.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.76 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Basilicata et al. 2024, the stellar radius of HAT-P-11 b's parameter set from Basilicata et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.127B/abstract): 528,732 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.811 +/- 0.03 solar masses from An et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HAT-P-11 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...22A/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4780 +/- 50 K from Basilicata et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-11 b's parameter set from Basilicata et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.127B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Basilicata et al. 2024, the stellar temperature of HAT-P-11 b's parameter set from Basilicata et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.127B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hat-p-11.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.585, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): spectral type K4, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.31 dex, from Basilicata et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A&A...686A.127B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.56702, from Q1-Q17 DR25 Supplemental KOI Table (https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/Kepler_KOI_docs.html)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): age 2.69 Gyr, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): rotation period 30.5 d, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HAT-P-11 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 0.67 km/s, from Bourrier et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...669A..63B/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.76 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.531. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
